destinations.name: Bali
destinations.description: A tropical paradise known for its forested volcanic mountains, iconic rice paddies, beaches and coral reefs.
destinations.long_description:
Bali enchants with its dramatic dances and colorful ceremonies, its arts and crafts, and its luxurious beach resorts and exciting nightlife. From the artistic heart of Ubud to the stunning cliffside temple of Uluwatu, every corner of this Indonesian island offers something magical.

Explore ancient Hindu temples perched on sea cliffs, wander through emerald rice terraces that cascade down hillsides, or dive into crystal-clear waters teeming with tropical marine life.

destinations.name: Machu Picchu
destinations.description: The legendary lost city of the Incas, perched high in the Andes mountains of Peru.
destinations.long_description:
Machu Picchu stands as one of the most remarkable achievements of ancient civilization. This 15th-century Incan citadel sits atop a mountain ridge at 2,430 meters above sea level, surrounded by dramatic peaks and cloud forests.

The site features more than 150 buildings ranging from baths to temples to sanctuaries, all connected by over 100 flights of stone steps.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.description: A tropical nation of crystal-clear waters, white sand beaches, and luxurious overwater villas.
destinations.long_description:
The Maldives is a tropical paradise like no other. Comprising 26 atolls and over 1,000 coral islands, this Indian Ocean nation offers some of the most pristine beaches and clearest waters on Earth.

Stay in iconic overwater bungalows, snorkel alongside manta rays and whale sharks, or simply relax on powdery white sand beaches surrounded by impossible shades of blue.

destinations.name: Tokyo
destinations.description: A dazzling metropolis where ancient traditions blend seamlessly with cutting-edge technology.
destinations.long_description:
Tokyo is a city of contrasts — where neon-lit skyscrapers tower over serene centuries-old temples, and where you can find both the world's most innovative technology and the most carefully preserved traditions.

From the famous Shibuya Crossing to the peaceful Meiji Shrine, from Michelin-starred restaurants to tiny ramen shops in back alleys, Tokyo offers endless discovery.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: March to May or October to November

destinations.name: Swiss Alps
destinations.description: Majestic snow-capped peaks, pristine lakes, and charming alpine villages in the heart of Europe.
destinations.long_description:
The Swiss Alps are the epitome of mountain grandeur. Towering peaks like the Matterhorn and Jungfrau rise dramatically above green valleys dotted with picturesque villages, crystal-clear lakes, and flower-filled meadows.

Whether you're skiing world-class slopes in winter, hiking through wildflower meadows in summer, or simply taking in the views from a scenic train ride, the Swiss Alps deliver an experience that feeds the soul.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: June to September or December to March

destinations.name: Paris
destinations.description: The City of Light — world-renowned for its art, cuisine, fashion, and iconic landmarks.
destinations.long_description:
Paris needs no introduction. The French capital has captivated travelers for centuries with its elegant boulevards, world-class museums, romantic ambiance, and culinary excellence.

From the Eiffel Tower to the Louvre, from the charming streets of Montmartre to the grandeur of Versailles, Paris offers a timeless blend of history, culture, and joie de vivre.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: April to June or September to November

destinations.name: Sahara Desert
destinations.description: Endless golden sand dunes stretching to the horizon — the world's largest hot desert.
destinations.long_description:
The Sahara is an adventure for the senses. Spanning 9.2 million square kilometers across North Africa, it offers some of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth — towering sand dunes, ancient oases, and star-filled skies unlike anything you've ever seen.

A camel trek through the Erg Chebbi dunes at sunset and a night spent under billions of stars in a Berber camp will change your perspective on the world forever.

destinations.name: Amazon Rainforest
destinations.description: The lungs of the Earth — a vast wilderness of incredible biodiversity and natural wonder.
destinations.long_description:
The Amazon Rainforest is the largest tropical rainforest on Earth, covering over 5.5 million square kilometers and home to 10% of all species on the planet.

Navigate winding rivers through dense canopy, spot exotic wildlife from pink river dolphins to howler monkeys, and immerse yourself in indigenous cultures that have thrived here for thousands of years.

destinations.name: New York City
destinations.description: The city that never sleeps — an electrifying mosaic of culture, entertainment, and iconic landmarks.
destinations.long_description: New York City is a global powerhouse of culture, finance, entertainment, and cuisine. From the neon glow of Times Square to the green expanse of Central Park, from world-class Broadway shows to the solemnity of the Statue of Liberty, NYC offers a density of experiences unmatched anywhere on Earth.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: April to June or September to November
